_why: R14 grading pass (2026-09-24): the old expect only checked the SECTION's top was above innerHeight, which reads true even for a section that starts off-screen above the fold (a negative top) or one whose actionable ROW is scrolled well past the bottom edge (the exact bug: scrollTop stuck at 0, row rect {top:854.5,bottom:907} inside a 900px panel — the section itself was arguably 'reachable', the ROW was not). Strengthened to require the specific 'Writing helper' row (the same DOM id SkillsToolsTab's needsSetupRowDomId + ProjectView's scroll effect both target) to be FULLY inside the viewport, not just started before its bottom edge.

shots.name: unavailable-opens-project-setup

actions.click: js:[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Writing helper unavailable on this device; open project setup"] span')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Unavailable')

shots.expect: js:!!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Skills & tools"]') && (()=>{const row=document.getElementById('project-tools-needing-setup-item-self:writing-helper');if(!row)return false;const r=row.getBoundingClientRect();return r.height>0 && r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=innerHeight;})()
